target: Shared minimum-18 geographic completion for VII place searches
natural_destination: Public VII vacation, events, spa and hourly result pages

requirements.statement: Sparse recognized locations fill to 18 eligible distinct places
Hard filters and availability remain enforced
Counts, list, map and disclosure agree
Public deployment is verified and rollback retained

risks.risk: Nearby fill introduces ineligible or unavailable places
Global sorting moves nearby places ahead of exact matches
One world or structured data keeps the old three-result contract
Unknown or whole-country searches are padded incorrectly

cases.oracle: 18 distinct items with exact three first and appended items nearest-first

cases.preconditions: Restrictive dates and filters leave 7 eligible places
cases.action: Complete from the filtered eligible pool
cases.oracle: Exactly the 7 eligible places appear; no unavailable item is added

cases.preconditions: Representative sparse routes in all four worlds
cases.oracle: Every family uses the shared 18-result contract without layout overflow

cases.action: Toggle map, reload, back and reopen
cases.oracle: URL state persists and count, list, markers and disclosure agree

cases.preconditions: Unknown location or eligible inventory under 18
cases.action: Submit the unknown or genuinely short location through the public search control
cases.oracle: Unknown location is not padded; genuine shortage returns only real eligible items

cases.preconditions: Whole-country or exact location already has at least 18
cases.action: Submit the whole-country or dense-location search through its normal route
cases.oracle: No sparse-location padding or truncation is applied

cases.preconditions: Exact candidate hash and prior rollback identity recorded
cases.action: Deploy once and poll bounded terminal state
cases.oracle: One succeeded deployment identity is recorded; uncertain result is not retried

cases.action: Open the supplied production URL fresh on desktop and mobile
cases.oracle: At least 18 results are exposed and the first exact משמר הירדן places remain first

out_of_scope: Mutating supplier catalog records or coordinates
Creating bookings, payments or outbound customer messages
